items.summary:
1/ Russian forces in the Lyman salient are being hampered by an "acute" shortage of supplies and personnel, according to Russian reports. They are said to be facing a difficult and deteriorating situation as Ukraine's counteroffensive continues. ⬇️
AMK Mapping 🇳🇿 (@AMK_Mapping_)
Situation on the Lyman direction, Donetsk Oblast:
Over the last two weeks, Ukrainian forces continued their counteroffensive north of Lyman, and have made additional tactically important advances, crossing into Luhansk Oblast and coming close to eliminating the Russian Zherebets River bridgehead.
In the north, after recapturing the village of Hrekivka, Ukrainian forces continued to advance deeper into Luhansk Oblast, pushing southeast down a tributary of the Zherebets River and each into the forests west of Makiivka, working to push the remaining Russian forces out of their strongpoints between Hrekivka and Makiivka. Simultaneously, other assault groups were able to break through Russian lines east of Novomykhailivka, entering a number of forested areas along the Donetsk-Luhansk regional border, prompting Russia to retreat from the newly formed salient southwest of Hrekivka. The loss of these forward positions has allowed Ukraine to begin supporting their push east of Hrekivka by attacking in an easterly direction from the Novomykhailivka area, entering advancing towards the village of Balka Zhuravka (formerly called Nevske).
The advance on Balka Zhuravka is taking place from both the northwest and west. From the west, Ukrainian assault groups consolidated in the forests east of Katerynivka and broke through to the larger forests northwest of Novolyubivka, which they are now storming from multiple directions. This has allowed some Ukrainian DRG groups to cross the Zherebets River via Novolyubivka and begin operating in the area of Balka Zhuravka and Terny, east of the river.
To the south, Ukrainian forces continued advancing down the gulley stretching southeast from Katerynivka to Novosadove, reaching the Zherebets River at a new point, and beginning fighting for the forested areas north of Ivanivka. items.title: Russian forces struck civilian transport in two attacks in Ukraine. A Russian drone hit a scheduled bus in the Nikopol district of Dnipropetrovsk region, killing 5 people and injuring 7, according to regional authorities. Russian forces also attacked the Kyiv-Mykolaiv passenger train. Ukrzaliznytsia says its monitoring team provided an early warning, allowing all passengers, locomotive crew and train staff to evacuate before the strike. No one on the train was injured. #Ukraine

Two Democrats, Jared Golden and Marie Gluesenkamp Perez, joined Republicans to advance the measure. The legislation would give Trump tariff authority against countries buying Russian energy, target Russia's shadow fleet, military figures and foreign suppliers, ban new US investment in Russia, tighten military-related export restrictions and extend sanctions on Iran. #Russia

Zelensky opened up about his trips to Moldova recently.
NOELREPORTS 🇪🇺 🇺🇦 (@NOELreports)
Zelensky says Russia twice sent drones into Moldovan airspace while his presidential plane was traveling via Chisinau in recent weeks. He told CBS News the first incident occurred while his plane was in Moldova before departing for Oslo, while another drone incursion happened as he returned through Chisinau days later. "Maybe they didn't want to attack me personally," Zelensky said, but he believes the incidents were intended to intimidate him and were part of a broader Russian strategy. #Ukraine
